title: input: fall back to active output for unmapped tablet/touch devices
body:
mapped_output_for_device() only fell back to builtin_output(), which returns None on any setup without an internal (laptop) display and no manual map_to_output config. This silently dropped every tablet/touch event before reaching tablet-protocol handling. Fall back to seat.active_output() instead, mirroring the pattern already used for the Ei input branch a few lines above. Twelve lines were generated with an LLM and added by hand to the actual code.

Fixes the root cause described in #3881.
